title: Two conversations on one EmDash site take turns writing, and Stop sends nothing while waiting
steps: S1: two conversations write one EmDash site.
S2: Stop while an EmDash write waits for the lease.
S3: tracy_emdash, media.upload and content.replace while another holds the lease.
expect: S1: B waits, A writes on, B writes after A's turn ends.
S2: nothing sent, even when the lease frees then.
S3: every road acquires first; none writes meanwhile.
evidence: Review 19/10/2026: EmDash writes went straight to the site's MCP with no write lease
fence: Every EmDash write acquires the site write lease

tests: 🔒 Q1: two conversations on one EmDash site — B waits for A, A writes on meanwhile, B writes once A’s turn ends
🔒 Q1: Stop while an EmDash write waits for the lease — nothing is sent, also when the lease comes free just then
🔒 Q1: every EmDash write road takes the lease first — tracy_emdash, media.upload, content.replace — and none writes while another holds it
